To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the addition of rubber granulate to the composition of SMA8 LA asphalt mixtures, with bitumen modified by SBS and crumb rubber, increases their elasticity, which results in lower tire/road noise.

the addition of rubber granules to SMA8 LA mix with bitumen 70/100 and SBS copolymers increases the stiffness modulus, reduces the hysteresis losses, and reduces the water damage resistance and resistance to degradation in the Cantabre abrasion loss test.

the use of rubber granulates in SMA8 LA mixture with the use of bitumen modified with SBS polymer and crumb rubber allows to obtain a low-noise road surface with good structural durability and water resistance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the possibility of reducing the amount of rubber in asphalt mixtures, which is currently a problem in Poland, and at the same time obtaining a positive effect on the reduction of tire/road noise.
the possibility of using rubber granulate in a proportion of 20-30% to produce low-noise SMA8 LA mix with a high resistance to water damage, abrasion, and fatigue.
the possibility of using a mixture containing 20% of rubber granulates in the SMA8 LA layer, which will be characterized by good durability, good noise reduction, and good noise reduction properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the addition of rubber granulate increases the elasticity of asphalt mixtures and reduces the noise generated by the tire rolling over the road.
the use of rubber granulates in the composition of SMA8 LA is a good solution for reducing tire/road rolling noise, but the amount of this component should be limited to 30% by weight.

the use of rubber granules in the composition of the SMA8 LA mixture, as well as using a modified binder, has a positive effect on improving the viscoelastic properties and the noise reduction properties of the asphalt mixture.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SMA8 LA mix with 10% rubber granulate is the most durable and has the highest elasticity.
the use of rubber granulates in SMA8 LA mixes, as a factor reducing the tire/road noise, is possible, but the use of modified bitumens is necessary.
the use of SMA8 LA with rubber granulate in low-noise layers is a promising solution for reducing tire/road rolling noise.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of rubber granulates and modified bitumen in SMA8 LA layers is a promising method for reducing tire/road rolling noise.
the addition of rubber granulate to SMA8 LA mix with bitumen 70/50 modified with crumb rubber is the most effective way of increasing the elasticity of asphalt mixture.
SMA LA with rubber granulate can be a low-noise road surface with a higher structural durability than porous asphalt.
